name: codex-telegram-plugin
description: Control Codex sessions, answer questions, and approve actions through either a shared OpenCode Telegram bot or a standalone Telegram receiver.

interface.shortDescription: Codex remote control through shared or standalone Telegram
interface.longDescription: Adds Telegram question, approval, completion, status, and session-resume support. Installations can reuse an existing OpenCode bot without copying its token or run an independent single-poller receiver.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Codex Telegram integration for questions and approvals while you work.
